LanguageData.RLE_AdvancedMetalSmeltingFurnaces.descri: A specialized large-scale device for refining metal materials. Consumes a very large amount of power. Installing a dedicated upgrade facility significantly improves work speed.
LanguageData.RLE_AdvancedMetalSmeltingFurnaces.label: Advanced Metal Smelter
LanguageData.RLE_ArtificialCoal.description: Artificial coal manufactured from wood using a high-temperature compression device installed in an Advanced Metal Smelter. Used as a smelting material.
LanguageData.RLE_ArtificialCoal.label: Artificial coal
LanguageData.RLE_AutomatiHybridRockMiner.description: Surface ~ A large drill machine that automatically mines 'Basalt', which is widely distributed in relatively shallow underground layers. Because it mines at a slow speed and does not mine depths outside the insect habitat, it will not agitate insects.\nMining intervals vary slightly due to the condition of the mining location, but it mines one 'Chunk of Basalt' approximately every 3 hours.\nIt requires power to operate and needs a lot of Steel for construction.
LanguageData.RLE_AutomatiHybridRockMiner.label: Basalt rock auto-mining device
LanguageData.RLE_AutomaticDeepRockMiner.description: Large drill machine that automatically mines 'Deep Rock' distributed at very deep locations. It mines beyond the depth of insect habitats at a slow speed, so it does not disturb insects.\nMining intervals vary slightly due to terrain conditions, but it mines one chunk of 'Deep Rock' approximately every 5 hours.\nIt requires electricity to operate and needs a significant amount of steel for construction.
LanguageData.RLE_AutomaticDeepRockMiner.label: Deep-depth rock auto-mining device
LanguageData.RLE_AuxiliaryCoolingUnit.description: Upgrade Equipment. A device that dissipates heat generated within the unit during fiber synthesis to improve efficiency. Work speed +20% Maximum connectable distance: 6 Simultaneous connectable count: 2 Connectable equipment: Chemical Fiber Manufacturing Unit
LanguageData.RLE_AuxiliaryCoolingUnit.label: Auxiliary Cooling Unit
LanguageData.RLE_BadDevilCloth.description: A special fabric chemically synthesized from fibers harvested from Devilstrand.
LanguageData.RLE_BadDevilCloth.label: Bad Devil Cloth
LanguageData.RLE_BioConcrete.description: A durable material made with crushed stone as aggregate and bound with synthetic resin.
LanguageData.RLE_BioConcrete.label: Bioconcrete
LanguageData.RLE_BlocksDeepStone.description: A shaped block of deep rock. Very hard with moderate toughness and durable.
LanguageData.RLE_BlocksDeepStone.label: Deep Rock Block
LanguageData.RLE_BlocksHybridRock.description: A shaped block of basalt. Strength cannot be expected, but it is moderately easy to handle.
LanguageData.RLE_BlocksHybridRock.label: Basalt Block
LanguageData.RLE_BoostSmelter.description: Refines metals from scrap iron, slag, and other materials. Extremely high electricity consumption, but enables very rapid progress in operations.
LanguageData.RLE_BoostSmelter.label: High-output blast furnace
LanguageData.RLE_CMTCleaner.description: Upgrade Facility. Removes floating dust around the area using an air filter, preventing component defects caused by dirt accumulation. +20% Work Speed Maximum Connectable Distance: 6 Simultaneous Connectable Count: 2 Connectable Facilities: Component Dedicated Fabricator
LanguageData.RLE_CMTCleaner.label: Basic Cleaning Bench
LanguageData.RLE_CeramicPowder.description: Powder created by crushing stone and heating it under high pressure. Used as a material for composite substances.
LanguageData.RLE_CeramicPowder.label: Ceramic powder
LanguageData.RLE_ChemicalFiberProcessingMachine.descr: Processes biofuel to manufacture chemical fibers. In addition to producing synthetic fabric usable as normal cloth from biofuel, it can also create synthetic fabrics with special properties by adding specific materials. Installing dedicated upgrade equipment significantly improves work speed.
LanguageData.RLE_ChemicalFiberProcessingMachine.label: Chemical Fiber Manufacturing Device
LanguageData.RLE_ChunkDeepStone.description: Chunk of Deep Rock. Very hard, with moderate toughness and durable.
LanguageData.RLE_ChunkDeepStone.label: Chunk of Deep Rock
LanguageData.RLE_ChunkHybridRock.description: Chunk of basalt. A rock widely distributed from the surface to relatively shallow strata. Strength cannot be expected, but it contains many artifacts and is moderately easy to handle.
LanguageData.RLE_ChunkHybridRock.label: Chunk of Basalt
LanguageData.RLE_ComponentMT.description: A specialized device for manufacturing components and advanced components. Designed with minimal functionality to save space. Installing a dedicated upgrade facility significantly improves work speed.
LanguageData.RLE_ComponentMT.label: Component Dedicated Fabricator
LanguageData.RLE_DustCollectionUnit.description: Upgrade Facility. Recovers dust generated during processing, making cleaning and maintenance easier. +30% Work Speed Maximum Connectable Distance: 6 Simultaneous Connectable Count: 2 Connectable Facilities: Expanded Rock Processor
LanguageData.RLE_DustCollectionUnit.label: Dust Recovery Unit
LanguageData.RLE_ElectButcher.description: Large table that processes dead creatures into small chunks of raw meat. Equipped with a processing electric saw, it can process quickly.
LanguageData.RLE_ElectButcher.label: Electric Meat Grinder
LanguageData.RLE_ElectStoveBoost.description: An electric stove with a built-in food preparation counter. Features power so intense that ordinary people cannot handle it, cooking instantly. (Cooking speed 200%)
LanguageData.RLE_ElectStoveBoost.label: Master's Electric Stove
LanguageData.RLE_ElectStoveChaos.description: An electric stove with a built-in food preparation counter. Unless you are a culinary master who has reached the realm of gods, ingredients will turn to charcoal. (Cooking speed 250%)
LanguageData.RLE_ElectStoveChaos.label: Purgatory Electric Stove
LanguageData.RLE_ElectStoveDash.description: An electric stove with a built-in food preparation counter. Features extremely high heat output. (Cooking speed 150%)
LanguageData.RLE_ElectStoveDash.label: Professional Electric Stove
LanguageData.RLE_ElectStoveFast.description: Electric stove with a built-in food preparation counter. High heat. (Cooking speed 125%)
LanguageData.RLE_ElectStoveFast.label: High-heat electric stove
LanguageData.RLE_ElectStoveHalf.description: Electric stove with a built-in food preparation counter. Very low heat due to cheap construction materials. (Cooking speed 50%)
LanguageData.RLE_ElectStoveHalf.label: Low-heat electric stove
LanguageData.RLE_ElectStoveNormal.description: Electric stove with a built-in food preparation counter.
LanguageData.RLE_ElectStoveNormal.label: Standard electric stove
LanguageData.RLE_ElectStoveSlow.description: Electric stove with a built-in food preparation counter. Low heat due to steel conservation. (Cooking speed 75%)
LanguageData.RLE_ElectStoveSlow.label: Medium-heat electric stove
LanguageData.RLE_ExpandedButcherMeatMaker.description: Advanced meat processing device that harvests edible parts such as meat, organs, brains, and bone marrow. Uses a short-range accelerated electron beam laser to quickly harvest edible parts without waste.\nDisadvantages include the size of the device and power consumption.\nDue to the risk of adverse effects from electron beams, mechs cannot operate it.
LanguageData.RLE_ExpandedButcherMeatMaker.label: High-Speed Meat Processing Unit
LanguageData.RLE_ExpandedChemfuelRefiningReactor.desc: An upgraded oil processing facility designed to efficiently produce biofuel from organic matter. It produces biofuel more efficiently than standard refineries.\nIn addition to raw meat, raw vegetables, and livestock products, it can also process corpses directly without dismembering them.\nInstalling dedicated upgrade equipment nearby significantly improves work speed.
LanguageData.RLE_ExpandedRockChunkCutter.description: A stone processing unit with expanded functions to perform rock cutting quickly. Equipped with a large, thin electric cutter for efficient rock cutting. Naturally, it can also perform most tasks done by a normal Stone Cutter. As an expanded function, the built-in large hammer can crush rock masses and sort out only the necessary substances contained within the stone. Installing a dedicated upgrade equipment significantly improves work speed.
LanguageData.RLE_ExpandedRockChunkCutter.label: Expanded Rock Processing Machine
LanguageData.RLE_ExpansiontypeRefiningUnit.descriptio: Upgrade Facility. A device that assists the reaction of the Advanced Metal Smelter. Work Speed +60% Maximum Connectable Distance: 6 Simultaneous Connectable Count: 2 Connectable Facilities: Advanced Metal Smelter
LanguageData.RLE_ExpansiontypeRefiningUnit.label: Expansion Refiner

LanguageData.RLE_FloorpaintWmd.description: This area marks a location for storing dangerous weapons or projectiles with immense destructive power.

LanguageData.RLE_FloorpaintWmdRE.description: This area marks a location for storing dangerous weapons or projectiles with immense destructive power.

LanguageData.RLE_GeyserResourceCollector.description: A large device that filters minerals contained in steam and hot water erupting from intermittent springs and dispenses them once a certain amount has accumulated. The power required for operation is supplied by an internal geothermal power generator, and 500W of surplus power can be used for other facilities.\nThis device does not sort resources finely but dispenses them as 'Chunks of Recovered Resources', so an 'Expanded Rock Processing Machine' capable of sorting resources separately is required.\nThe dispensing interval for one 'Chunk of Recovered Resources' is approximately 5 days, and variations occur due to the condition of the intermittent spring.
LanguageData.RLE_GeyserResourceCollector.label: Intermittent Spring Resource Recovery Device
LanguageData.RLE_GeyserResourceRock.description:
Resource lump recovered by the Geothermal Vent Resource Harvester. Can be crushed and sorted into multiple resources using an Expanded Rock Crusher.
Obtainable resources: Steel: 35, Plasteel: 7, Gold: 4, Uranium: 6 (approximately equivalent to 200 Silver)
LanguageData.RLE_GeyserResourceRock.label: Recovered resource lump
LanguageData.RLE_HighCarbonResin.description: A durable material made with crushed stone as aggregate and bound with synthetic resin. Woven with carbon fibers, it is extremely strong. It is heavy and black. Ideal for wall construction but very difficult to work with.
LanguageData.RLE_HighCarbonResin.label: High-carbon concrete
LanguageData.RLE_HighGradeSyntheticCloth.description: Inferior to Shinsleather but tougher than normal fabric.
LanguageData.RLE_HighGradeSyntheticCloth.label: High-Grade Synthetic Fabric
LanguageData.RLE_HighSmelter.description: Refines metals from scrap iron, slag, and other materials. Consumes a large amount of electricity but delivers corresponding power, completing work faster than a standard blast furnace. (Work speed 150%)
LanguageData.RLE_HighSmelter.label: High-power blast furnace
LanguageData.RLE_HydroponicsWithSunHigh.description: Standard artificial grower with a small solar lamp (fertility 350%). Because the pump that circulates nutrient-rich water must always be running, plants will rapidly die if power is cut off.
LanguageData.RLE_HydroponicsWithSunHigh.label: High-spec Hydroponic Grower with Solar Lamp (3x3 tiles)
LanguageData.RLE_HydroponicsWithSunLow.description: Standard artificial grower with a small solar lamp (fertility 180%). Because the pump that circulates nutrient-rich water must always be running, plants will rapidly die if power is cut off.
LanguageData.RLE_HydroponicsWithSunLow.label: Hydroponics Bay with Solar Lights (3x3) Easy Spec
LanguageData.RLE_HydroponicsWithSunNor.description: Standard-spec artificial cultivation unit equipped with a small solar light (fertility 280%). Because the pump circulating nutrient-rich water must always be operational, plants will rapidly die if power supply is interrupted.
LanguageData.RLE_HydroponicsWithSunNor.label: Hydroponics Bay with Solar Lights (3x3) Normal Spec
LanguageData.RLE_HydroponicsWithSunOmega.description: Standard spec artificial cultivation device equipped with a small sun lamp (fertility 2200%). Since the pump circulating nutrient-rich water must always be operating, plants will rapidly wither if power supply is cut off.
LanguageData.RLE_HydroponicsWithSunOmega.label: Hydroponic Grower with Sun Lamp (3x3 tiles) Omega Spec
LanguageData.RLE_HydroponicsWithSunVerSoil.descriptio: Special artificial grower simulating fertile soil with a small solar lamp (fertility 140%). This device allows you to grow plants that can only be cultivated in soil. However, maintaining growth requires a certain amount of power, and if power is cut off, plants will rapidly die.\nThis is only useful when you absolutely must grow something that can only be cultivated in soil under extreme environmental conditions.
LanguageData.RLE_HydroponicsWithSunVerSoil.label: Soil Simulation Grower with Solar Lamp (3x3 tiles)
LanguageData.RLE_ImpurityFiltrationUnit.description:
Upgrade equipment that rapidly removes impurities unnecessary for biofuel production.
Work Speed +35%
Maximum Connectable Distance: 6
Simultaneous Connectable Count: 1
Connectable Equipment: Advanced Biofuel Refinery & Reactor
LanguageData.RLE_ImpurityFiltrationUnit.label: Impurity Filter Unit
LanguageData.RLE_IntegratedManagementDevice.descripti:
Upgrade Facility. Monitors the operation status of manufacturing devices and controls output adjustments and engine cooling timing, etc.
Work speed +25%
Maximum connectable distance: 18
Simultaneous connectable count: 1
Connectable devices: Manufacturing equipment added by this MOD
LanguageData.RLE_IntegratedManagementDevice.label: Integrated Control Unit
LanguageData.RLE_LowSmelter.description: Refines metals from scrap iron and slag. Built to save steel, resulting in poor thermal efficiency. (Work Speed 75%)
LanguageData.RLE_LowSmelter.label: Medium Firepower Blast Furnace
LanguageData.RLE_MechaScrappertable.description: Specialized workbench for quickly disassembling mechanoids and recovering resources.
LanguageData.RLE_MechaScrappertable.label: Mechanoid Disassembly Table
LanguageData.RLE_MetalIngotPlasteel.description: A large ingot made by consolidating 325 plastic units. Can be broken down into 325 plastic units in a smelter. Due to its immense size and weight, it cannot be used directly for any processing. An orbital trader focused on resource collection might buy it at a high price.
LanguageData.RLE_MetalIngotPlasteel.label: Plastic Large Ingot
LanguageData.RLE_MetalIngotSilver.description: A large ingot made by consolidating 3250 silver units. Can be broken down into 3250 silver units in a smelter. Due to its immense size and weight, it cannot be used directly for any processing. An orbital trader focused on resource collection might buy it at a high price.
LanguageData.RLE_MetalIngotSilver.label: Silver Large Ingot
LanguageData.RLE_MetalIngotSteel.description: A large ingot formed by fusing 325 units of steel. Can be divided into 325 units of steel in a smelter. So massive and heavy that it cannot be used directly for any processing. An orbital trader focused on resource collection might buy it at a high price.
LanguageData.RLE_MetalIngotSteel.label: Large steel ingot
LanguageData.RLE_MetalIngotUranium.description: A large ingot made by consolidating 325 uranium units. Can be broken down into 325 uranium units in a smelter. Due to its immense size and weight, it cannot be used directly for any processing. An orbital trader focused on resource collection might buy it at a high price.
LanguageData.RLE_MetalIngotUranium.label: Uranium Large Ingot
LanguageData.RLE_NormalSmelter.description: Refines metals from scrap iron, slag, and other materials. (Work speed 100%)
LanguageData.RLE_NormalSmelter.label: Standard Blast Furnace

LanguageData.RLE_ReinforcedSyntheticResin.description: Reinforced resin with higher carbon concentration, processed from bio-liquefied fuel. Properties are similar to steel.
LanguageData.RLE_ReinforcedSyntheticResin.label: Reinforced Synthetic Resin
LanguageData.RLE_Rutileblock.description: Titanium ore used as raw material for producing Titanium. When heated and melted in a blast furnace, it can be separated into Steel and Titanium Slag.
LanguageData.RLE_Rutileblock.label: Ilmenite (Titanium Ore)
LanguageData.RLE_SlowSmelter.description: Refines metals from scrap iron and slag. Built by skimping on materials to make it barely functional, its firepower is quite weak. (Work Speed 50%)
LanguageData.RLE_SlowSmelter.label: Meager Blast Furnace
LanguageData.RLE_Superweave.description: Reinforced Synthetic Fiber. Much better than Synthread and tougher.
LanguageData.RLE_Superweave.label: Superwave
LanguageData.RLE_SyntheticResin.description: Standard synthetic resin processed from bio-liquefied fuel. Properties are similar to wood.
LanguageData.RLE_SyntheticResin.label: Synthetic Resin
LanguageData.RLE_SyntheticResinProcessingMachine.desc: A device that processes bio-liquefied fuel to manufacture synthetic resin. It can also produce resins with special properties by adding specific materials. Installing a dedicated upgrade equipment significantly improves work speed.
LanguageData.RLE_TTAlloy.description: An alloy of tungsten and titanium. A metal that improves processability while utilizing the hardness of tungsten, with excellent corrosion resistance.
LanguageData.RLE_TTAlloy.label: W-Ti Alloy
LanguageData.RLE_TTCEAlloy.description: A material that was once used as armor for combat weapons on a certain planet. It maintains armor performance while improving workability and reducing weight.
LanguageData.RLE_TTCEAlloy.label: Titanium Alloy Ceramic Composite
LanguageData.RLE_Titanium.description: An excellent metal that is strong yet lighter than steel, with superior corrosion resistance. While its raw materials are widely distributed, the refining process requires extremely high technology, resulting in a prevalence rate on this planet that is overwhelmingly lower than plasteel. Its hardness makes it difficult to work with.
LanguageData.RLE_Titanium.label: Titanium (Titan)
LanguageData.RLE_TitaniumSlug.description: High-purity titanium ore derived from titanium dioxide. Can be processed in a high-grade metal smelter to produce Titanium (Titanium).
LanguageData.RLE_TitaniumSlug.label: Titanium Slag
LanguageData.RLE_Tungsten.description: A hard, heavy, difficult-to-process, and robust metal. Its difficulty in processing makes it challenging to handle. While strong against blades, it is weak against large impacts.
LanguageData.RLE_Tungsten.label: Tungsten
LanguageData.RLE_TungstenCarbide.description: An alloy of tungsten and carbon. Harder than tungsten itself, difficult to process, and an ultra-tough metal. In terms of hardness, it ranks second only to diamond. Its handling is difficult due to its difficulty in processing. It is strong against blades but weak against large impacts.
LanguageData.RLE_TungstenCarbide.label: Tungsten Carbide
LanguageData.RLE_TungstenOxide.description: Powder that serves as the raw material for tungsten. It can be processed in a high-grade metal smelter to produce tungsten.
LanguageData.RLE_TungstenOxide.label: Tungsten Oxide
LanguageData.RLE_UnfinishedChemProduct.label: Incomplete synthetic fiber
LanguageData.RLE_UnfinishedMetalProduct.label: Incomplete metal
LanguageData.RLE_UnfinishedResinProduct.label: Incomplete synthetic resin
LanguageData.RLE_Wolframite.description: Tungsten ore, which is the raw material for producing tungsten. Refining it in a high-grade metal smelter allows you to purify tungsten oxide.
LanguageData.RLE_Wolframite.label: Wolframite (tungsten ore)
